title: CMPT 276 take-home assessments with AI disclosure
summary: Students may use GenAI in weekly labs, biweekly assignments, and a final group software project, but must submit an AI-use disclosure with prompts and responses. Closed-book quizzes and the midterm prohibit AI and provide a secure comparison point.

sources.title: Experience Report: Adopting AI-Usage Policy in Software Engineering Education
